description: Ministry  of Defence - List of the Air Force Personnel approved to award the Videsha Sewa Padakkama
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces personnel awards (Videsha Sewa Padakkama) to specific named Air Force personnel (Wg Cdr GTUI Wijerathne and Wg Cdr PN Gunathilake). It contains individual names and basic titles/ranks but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, government structural changes, or specialized non-governmental matters. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it focuses solely on government personnel recognition without portfolio details.
